title: SDM Camera Of The Past
body:
SDM Camera Of The Past - this is a mod that adds an alternative version of the grave mod.

The mod can currently store up to 5 player deaths, after which they will start to be overwritten. At the moment, the mod is in Beta and has little functionality from what is being thought about.

![preview](https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbHg0dWVnbXU2YnZvZDNxd29qNzJyczgxeGU1NndzeHVxcHdsdjlpciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/kI1rbCcuIgZGORjcfQ/giphy.gif)

Mod features

• A convenient API for integrating mods

• The ability to save multiple inventories
